caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of four reasoning categories—Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning—within a dataset.
